title: Functional end-to-end multimodal persistent computation without auxiliary representation supervision
question: Can the integrated PLM chain learn a held-out cross-modal task from multimodal observations alone, carrying information through persistent state into a later query and executing the requested Boolean computation end to end?
hypothesis: A jointly trained multimodal encoder, explicit persistent entity-addressed state, and fixed query-conditioned CASM dispatcher should solve the registered held-out cross-modal benchmark when trained only with final action supervision plus post-action verifier supervision; no payload-bit or entity auxiliary labels are provided to the model.

arms.name: normal
arms.intervention: full multimodal observation and persistent state

arms.name: no_memory
arms.intervention: zero persistent state immediately before q1

arms.name: shuffle_image
arms.intervention: permute image observations across the three observed entities

arms.name: text_only
arms.intervention: replace image and audio observations with constants

arms.name: image_only
arms.intervention: replace text and audio observations with constants

arms.name: audio_only
arms.intervention: replace text and image observations with constants

information_flow.pre_action: text/image/audio observations -> encoders -> shared representation -> explicit persistent entity write -> explicit entity read -> fixed query-conditioned CASM -> action
information_flow.post_action: predicted action -> environment outcome -> verifier -> outcome-gated state update
information_flow.operator_identity: public query metadata; operator discovery is explicitly out of scope for this integration lane

held_constant: same synthetic multimodal generator across training and evaluation
evaluation is generated only after training
no evaluation outcome is used for early stopping or model selection
controls reuse the exact same generated evaluation episode objects within each seed
E2E-001 and E2E-002 are invalidated/superseded provenance only
E2E-003 and E2E-004 are diagnostic historical comparators only and are not used for tuning
leakage_rules: q1 targets entities[0] and q2 targets entities[1], which are distinct
each query answer is computed from the named target entity payload only
training compositions are disjoint from registered held-out compositions
evaluation episodes are generated after all training steps using a separate RNG namespace
evaluation semantic keys are asserted not to overlap training episode keys
the model query interface contains no answer, target, outcome, reward, or verifier target argument
the training model receives final action labels only through the loss target; labels are never passed into query()
payload-bit and entity auxiliary representation supervision is disabled
post-action verifier feedback is computed only after the action and cannot affect that same action

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass, mean normal heldout q2 accuracy >= 0.80, and every seed >= 0.40
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that the registered synthetic multimodal persistent-computation chain can function end to end without auxiliary representation supervision
decision_rule.does_not_license: real-world multimodal understanding, semantic memory, learned operator discovery, scaling laws, AGI, or hardware claims

decision_rule.condition: integrity passes but the primary threshold fails
decision_rule.licenses: the current fixed functional configuration does not meet the registered synthetic capability criterion
decision_rule.does_not_license: architecture impossibility; optimisation changes are a separate later research phase

decision_rule.condition: any leakage, split, oracle, or gradient-surface gate fails

statistics.primary_aggregation: mean q2 per seed followed by seed-level bootstrap

scope: multimodal input from scratch; no pretrained external encoders
explicit entity addressing is a functional scaffold, not evidence for learned semantic addressing
fixed public operator dispatch is a functional scaffold, not evidence for autonomous operator discovery
no auxiliary representation labels at train or evaluation time
no optimisation/sweeps based on test outcomes

provenance.predecessor_use: historical diagnosis only; no measured outcome is used to select the current threshold, seed, hyperparameters, or held-out set

amendments.old_definition: the initial prototype exposed training targets inside an episode-level model forward method while query() itself remained label-free
amendments.new_definition: the model has no label-bearing episode-level forward method; the harness computes action loss outside the model and derives synthetic environment outcome only after action
amendments.rationale: Reduce the attack surface for target leakage and make the pre-action model boundary structurally auditable.
amendments.affected: implementation boundary only; benchmark, seeds, training steps, evaluation set, threshold and registered controls unchanged
amendments.scientific_status: No admissible E2E-005 result existed under the previous implementation.
